title: Count minimal generators of bounded powers of a bivariate monomial ideal

source.citation: Jutta Rath and Roswitha Rissner, Minimal generating sets of large powers of bivariate monomial ideals, arXiv:2503.21466

translation.notes: Noether forms powers 3 through 15 of the concrete bivariate monomial ideal and verifies their minimal-generator counts directly. This bounded experiment illustrates the source's eventual-growth problem without claiming its general structural theorem or arbitrary-scale performance.
